newsitem.title: CANADA: TrizecHahn buys two U.S. office buildings.
newsitem.headline: TrizecHahn buys two U.S. office buildings.

text.p: TrizecHahn Corp said Thursday it had purchased two office properties located in the southeastern United States for US$80 million.

The two properties -- Colony Square in Atlanta, Ga., and 1441 Main Street in Columbia, S.C. -- add over one million square feet of class A space to TrizecHahn's portfolio, the real estate company said.

TrizecHahn acquired the 819,000-square-foot Colony Square complex from Prudential Life Insurance Co of America. Financing was provided through TrizecHahn's acquisition facility with CS First Boston, announced in July.
TrizecHahn said the 258,000-square-foot Columbia property was purchased from New York Life Insurance Co.
Toronto-based TrizecHahn has acquired US$330 million of office properties in the United States since it was formed from the merger of Horsham Corp and Trizec last month.
"These acquisitions will immediately contribute to cash flow from operations," TrizecHahn said.
It also said it had completed a US$113 million non-recourse financing on Bankers Hall, its 1.1-million-square-foot office building in Calgary.
